subject: Island 014 Royal Palace buttressed hemidome naked macro shell

reviewPolicy.hiddenViews: volume-coherence only; source likeness is not scored where the source provides no exact hidden authority

perViewScores.note: Hemidomes now read as seated roof caps rather than full balls, removing the prior hard veto. The palace remains too narrow and pyramidal: its lower cathedral and shoulders do not create the source's broad inhabited base, while the upper lantern is disproportionately tall.
Oblique transition is closed and coherent. Satellite shoulders are still thin and low relative to the central keep, so the silhouette reads as a tapered monument rather than a dense cathedral.
Hidden side remains volumetrically sound; central height dominates while lower cross-body depth and tower shoulder mass are insufficient.
No collapse or open slot appears, but the family is still a narrow taper with subordinate satellites rather than the source's broad interlocked palace.
Rear volume is coherent and symmetric; lower cathedral and apse remain too small against the central keep.
Opposite transition confirms stable closed volume and the same underweight lower-body hierarchy.
Opposite side remains coherent; the tall narrow central axis and small tower shoulders dominate.
Front-adjacent view confirms corrected dome seating but insufficient cathedral breadth and satellite shoulder height.

largestMismatch: The source places a tall central keep inside a broad, dense cathedral base whose four shoulder towers rise strongly into the silhouette. This blockout solves dome seating but concentrates too much height in a narrow central taper, leaves the lower cathedral and satellites underweight, and extends the crown lantern too far above the hero dome.
